title: Stupendous Smeltery Accelerator
description: Blocks to help YOU accelerate YOUR Tinkers Smeltery!
body:
Adds four tiers of Smeltery Accelerators, which can be played on top of a Smeltery Controller to speed up the smeltery by 25% up to 200%!



Inspired by SOLs_Gaming's Simple Smeltery Accelerator, but no code or assets ahve been taken/borrowed.
